snippet.title: Prisoner of Ice gameplay (PC Game, 1995)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Prisoner of Ice (aka call of chtulhu: prisoner of ice), PC game produced by Infogrames in 1995 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/prisoner-of-ice/2148/
You're in a submarine at pole latitude and a strange thing is coming out of a wooden box..
Played through emulated Windows (Win 98/Win XP) virtual machine.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
